about.title: About
about.methodology.purpose: Lineage Lens is a camera-first LineageOS device specs and comparison tool (static-site / github-pages) — sensor size, OIS, and buying signals without a backend.
about.methodology.sources: Data merges the LineageOS wiki device YAMLs with a deep camera enrichment CSV (join key: codename). Missing fields stay visible with provenance.
about.methodology.scores: Camera, longevity, and worth-buying scores combine sensor size, OIS, optical zoom, maintainers, and age. Megapixels are not primary.
about.methodology.compare: Multi-select comparison and similar-camera search help you shortlist phones by optics, not marketing names.
detail.lead: Camera and LineageOS support snapshot for purchasing decisions.

settings.title: Settings
settings.sources.maker.rule: Can fill a field alone. Wins if another source disagrees.
settings.sources.regulatory.rule: FCC, EU energy label, or equivalent. Can fill the measurement it states.
settings.sources.teardown.rule: Can fill a part number when the chip marking is shown.
settings.sources.gsmarena.rule: Can fill a field the maker page does not state. A disagreement loses to the maker.
settings.sources.press.rule: Notebookcheck, PhoneArena, Android Authority prose. Needs a second source.
settings.sources.wiki.rule: Not a hardware fact. Catalog pitch and bitrate stay marked with *.

settings.faq.optics.title: How do the camera columns work?
settings.faq.optics.body: Each lens stacks under Sensor / PP / FF-eq focal / blur / sensor name / score. Blur combines sensor size, aperture, and framing. Overall score weights main higher; per-lens video is estimated when only device-level caps are known (older phones often 4K on main only). Megapixels are not primary.
